thumbSize.$description: The thumb, which sits at the start when off and the end when on.

inset.$description: The room between the thumb and the track's edge.

hit.$description: The row's minimum height, so the whole label is the target.

radius.$description: Track and thumb are fully rounded.

trackOn.$description: The track when on: filled, beside the position and the On text.

border.$description: The off track's outline, at least 3:1 against the surface.

thumbOn.$description: The thumb when on, on the accent track.

hover.$description: The off track under the pointer.

state.$description: The On or Off word and the description.

focusOffset.$description: The focus ring's gap from the track.

lineHeight.$description: The name line's line box, the same as every control label.

gap.$description: Between the track, the name and the state word.

labelSize.$description: The name, at body size like every form label (D-111).

stateSize.$description: The On or Off word and the description.

duration.$description: The thumb's slide; reduced motion makes it instant.

busyRing.$description: The spinner drawn in the thumb while a change is being saved (F2): the switch itself stays, focused and locked.

busyTrack.$description: The rest of the thumb's spinner ring.

spin.$description: One turn of the thumb's spinner; reduced motion stands it still.

busyThumb.$description: The thumb while it holds the spinner, so the ring reads on either track.
